requirements.title: IALL argument restrictions
requirements.definition: ARRAY shall be an integer array; DIM shall be an integer scalar in the valid rank range; MASK shall be logical and conformable with ARRAY.
requirements.oracle:
Original source registration only; selected facets now have bounded runtime fixtures and mutation plans. Future fixtures use exact integer, logical, character, shape, kind, and bit-pattern observations. Bit-producing intrinsic results are observed in bit context by BTEST, POPCNT, or bit-pattern comparisons, not by signed numeric interpretation of a result whose leftmost bit may be set. Each positive plan establishes a non-default state first, uses a non-vacuous companion for zero, .FALSE., blank, or identity results, and includes a feature mutation such as changing the intrinsic name, argument order, DIM, MASK, POS, LEN, KIND, or a BOZ literal. Unnumbered argument shall-restrictions are source-control restrictions only and are not promoted to diagnostic facets.

requirements.title: IALL DIM reduction applies IALL to each section
requirements.definition: IALL with DIM reduces each rank-one section selected along DIM, with optional MASK sections applied correspondingly; rank-one ARRAY with DIM equals the whole-array form.
